Insanely happy as our team Chain Breakers won the third prize at the #HackIndia2024 Final Spark. Our team consisted of  Shivam Mahajan ,Shivam Bajpai ,Shivanshu . and Shobit garg." "" "This was an intense Hackathon as we have to ideally make a fully functional web3 application in the time frame of about of a day." "Our project ChainCode was basically a coding platform that was proposed to solve the problem of a user not having the ownership of his intellectual rights of a unique solution even when the user was the pioneer in doing that kind of code and also having the trouble of going through many redundant codes to get a number of solutions for a particular solution." "We basically what we did was submit the user solution for a particular solution and then if it gets submitted, we use ai to run through all the unique solutions of that particular solution if it's unique we mint a nft on holesky that will be shown in the form of a card in user's my nft section." "" "Our future scope is to become the first web3 coding platform or get integrated with existing coding platforms." " " "Thanks to Shivam Bajpai and Shivanshu . for making the fullstack app and also the UI libraries like spline, shadcn and also tolerating my constant nagging. And Shobit garg to being a knowledge hub of information about everything web3 technologies and also the smart contract." "" "A huge thank you to Chitkara University, IEEE-CIET Student Branch, Chitkara ACM Student Chapter and Coding Blocks CUIET Chapter for organizing this amazing event and also being pretty chill when I was disturbing others. Special thanks to Stephen SIMON for being a good sport as we were continuously troubling him and a good orator."
